notes.title: Shivers, swag, shenanigans
notes.content:
Your quick peek at some the Halloween events in upjers games

The night of Halloween is looming ahead. This means it‘s party-time for upjers!

We want to give you an overview on the Halloween-Events starting across many games next 
week. Here‘s what you can expect:​

My Little Farmies

https://store.steampowered.com/app/789100/My_Little_Farmies/

From October 22nd to 29th the Halloween-themed collector-event is waiting for you. Decorate your village with eeriely-cute Voodoo decorations to collect all the Shrunken head-tokens to win valuable prizes like the new „Saddler‘s“ production facility. There you can craft saddles and other products.

My Free Zoo

https://store.steampowered.com/app/694130/My_Free_Zoo/

Is this too morbid for you? Then you may already be looking forward to collect Lionhead tokens at My Free Zoo. Put up scary-looking glow-in-the-dark animal statues to have the chance to win the adorable and very exclusive Siberian musk deer to exhibit in your zoo. (The events runs 
between October 23rd and 30th.)

My Free Farm

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1049880/My_Free_Farm/

This year the My Free Farm Halloween-Event is challenging your gray matter again! The Halloween card-matching game is back! When you mange to clear all cards from the table within ten tries, you have the chance to win new amusing trophies for your collection. (October 22nd 
through to November 5th.)

But also your  Horse Farm (24 – 30 October), Wauies (24 – 31 October), My Sunny Resort (23 – 30 October) and My Free Farm 2 (29 October – 5 November) are packed full with fun events 
to take the edge off the dark season.

notes.title: Cashback Sale!
notes.content:
Winter is on its way out and it's time to prepare the shop for the influx of spring customers and spruce things up a bit.

If you're rarin' to expand now, we have good news for you:                              

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31510958/9171ae379c1d994d6df2c3436585f1118a33d3e8.jpg

From Thursday, February 15, at 11:00 am until Sunday, February 18, at 11:59 pm CET, you'll have the chance to earn back a percentage of the Diamonds you spend in the game. This is a great chance to save on fancy decorations, pens, equipment, staff and more! The more you spend, the more you save - you can get up to 25% of the Diamonds you spend back!

But it gets even better!  At the 100 and 2000 thresholds, you'll also get a [color=#715E56]Bull Terrier on top of your Diamond reimbursement! 

The more Diamonds you spend, the more you'll get!

0-100 Diamonds: 5% of your Diamonds back
100-500 Diamonds: 10% of your Diamonds back + 1 Bull Terrier
500-1000 Diamonds: 15% of your Diamonds back 
1000-2000 Diamonds: 20% of your Diamonds back 
2000+ Diamonds: 25% of your Diamonds back +1 Bull Terrier

The card prizes are cumulative - that means if you spend 2000 Diamonds, you will get 500 Diamonds (25%) back and get a total of 2 Bull Terriers!

Bull Terriers are stubborn clowns. They can be a bit obstinate but are loving family dogs. They will feel most comfortable in upholstered, aspen bedding and straw enclosures.

The Diamonds will be paid out upon logging in between Monday, February 19, at 11:00 am and Monday, February 26, at 10:59 am CET.

In the game, you'll see a symbol on the right side of the screen that will show when the event starts, and later, what you'll get back. During the weekend event, all premium expenditures will be logged there, and you'll be shown what you'll get on Monday.
